    MADE FOR GOING AWAY

    The best part happens
    after you close this.

    A model that lives where you do. Multilingual MiniLM and Transformers.js turn your words into an embedding, then find a relevant mission from a small, curated library. Time, energy, and access preferences are firm filters.

    No invented destinations. No location tracking. No feed to come back to. Reflections are optional and stored only on this device. Model and library files download from Hugging Face and jsDelivr; your mood is never sent to an inference server.

    Open pieces & honest limits

    Multilingual MiniLM (ONNX weights) · Transformers.js. Matching measures semantic similarity, not certainty. This is a break planner, not route guidance, weather forecasting, or species identification. Download the model before heading out; browser caches may be evicted.

    Built for Hacktoberfest 2026 · Touch GrassSmall is a perfectly good adventure. ↗
